defects.description: The web proxy targets FLASK_SERVER_ADDR=backend:8080, but the backend serves on FLASK_SERVER_PORT=9091, so the proxy points at the wrong port.
paraphrases: The proxy sends traffic to backend:8080, but the backend listens on 9091.
FLASK_SERVER_ADDR should use port 9091 to match the backend.
Proxy target port (8080) does not match the backend port (9091).
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing FLASK_SERVER_ADDR (line 7) with FLASK_SERVER_PORT (line 19); should be 9091.

defects.description: web.depends_on names service `api`, but no such service is defined (the application service is named `backend`).
paraphrases: The web service depends on `api`, but the service is `backend`.
defects.rationale: Findable by cross-checking web.depends_on against the service list; the app service is `backend`.

defects.description: backend.depends_on names service `db`, but the database service is named `mongo`; there is no service `db`.
paraphrases: The backend depends on `db`, but the database service is `mongo`.
defects.rationale: Findable by cross-checking backend.depends_on against the service list; the DB service is `mongo`.
